answer: An attacker who floods the jury with fake votes also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes, because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer. The protection is robust because the trusted grader set is drawn from established agents, which keeps a sudden flood of new keys from capturing majority control. What this achieves is a system where the cost of an attack is public and provable, so the whole network can trust verdicts without trusting any single identity. Consider a ferrous as the anchor of the cost. A summit stands in for the reward an honest agent protects....
